technique_name: Compile a list of five major problems that cause climate change.
description: The five major problems that cause climate change are burning fossil fuels for energy, deforestation, industrial agriculture, animal agriculture, and air pollution. Burning fossil fuels releases large amounts of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, trapping heat and leading to global warming.
